entries.en: A waterproof bag became a must-have after the first wet journey to the island.
entries.zh: 第一次冒雨前往那座岛后，防水袋成了必需品。

entries.en: She scrubbed the soil from beneath her nails with a nail brush.
entries.zh: 她用指甲刷刷掉了指甲缝里的泥土。

entries.en: The nail file caught on a loose thread inside her washbag.
entries.zh: 指甲锉钩住了她洗漱包里的一根松线。

entries.en: He packed the nail scissors in a small case to protect their tips.
entries.zh: 他把修甲小剪刀装进小盒子里，保护剪刀尖。

entries.meaningZh: 爱炫耀自己认识名人的人
entries.en: The name-dropper kept mentioning famous guests but never answered my question about the food.
entries.zh: 那个爱炫耀自己认识名人的人不停提起名人宾客，却始终不回答我关于食物的问题。

entries.en: The seminar compared rival approaches to nation-building in the imaginary republic.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了那个虚构共和国在国家建构方面的不同主张。

entries.en: One of the cardboard stars fell during the school's nativity play.
entries.zh: 学校演出基督诞生剧时，一颗纸板星星掉了下来。

entries.en: The fictional company's plan relies on natural wastage rather than dismissing existing staff.
entries.zh: 那家虚构公司的计划依靠自然减员，而不是解雇现有员工。

entries.en: We left the nature trail when the path became too muddy for our shoes.
entries.zh: 小路变得泥泞，穿着我们的鞋不便行走，于是我们离开了那条自然景观小径。

entries.en: In the case study, negative equity prevented the owner from selling without a shortfall.
entries.zh: 在这个案例中，负资产使业主出售房屋后仍会有资金缺口。

entries.en: The two clubs returned to the negotiating table after their supporters demanded an agreement.
entries.zh: 球迷们要求达成协议后，两家俱乐部重新回到谈判桌前。

entries.en: A tear in the net curtain let a narrow strip of sunlight through.
entries.zh: 网眼窗帘上的一道裂口透进了一小条阳光。

entries.en: The technician replaced the network card after checking the cable and the settings.
entries.zh: 技术员检查电缆和设置后，更换了网卡。

entries.en: The orchestra needed new blood after several experienced players moved away.
entries.zh: 几位经验丰富的演奏者搬走后，乐团需要补充新生力量。

entries.meaningZh: 新到任的人〔常指想改革的负责人〕
entries.en: The office's new broom wanted to change the filing system before meeting the staff.
entries.zh: 办公室那位新到任的负责人还没见员工，就想改变归档制度。

entries.en: There was a new face at rehearsal, carrying a violin case and looking rather nervous.
entries.zh: 排练时出现了一张新面孔，那人拿着小提琴盒，看起来颇为紧张。

entries.en: The editor held back the news release until the spelling of every name had been checked.
entries.zh: 编辑暂未发出新闻稿，等着核对完所有姓名的拼写。

entries.en: The village news-sheet announced a change of venue for the gardening competition.
entries.zh: 村里的小报宣布园艺比赛改了场地。

entries.en: The night light cast a small yellow circle on the bedroom wall.
entries.zh: 夜灯在卧室墙上投下了一个小小的黄色光圈。

entries.meaningZh: 不是开玩笑的事；困难的事
entries.en: Carrying the piano up those stairs was no joke for the exhausted removal team.
entries.zh: 对疲惫的搬运队来说，把钢琴抬上那些楼梯可不是轻松的事。

entries.meaningZh: 严肃的事；不是闹着玩的事
entries.en: Losing the only copy of the accounts was no laughing matter for the small charity.
entries.zh: 对那家小慈善机构来说，丢失唯一一份账目可不是闹着玩的。

entries.en: An apology is no use unless it is followed by action.
entries.zh: 如果没有接下来的行动，道歉就没有用。

entries.en: The fictional pilot studies the boundary of the no-fly zone before changing course.
entries.zh: 那个虚构的飞行员先研究禁飞区的边界，再改变航向。

entries.en: Leaving dirty cups on the piano was a definite no-no in that rehearsal room.
entries.zh: 在那间排练室里，把脏杯子放在钢琴上是绝对不行的。

entries.en: The no-score draw disappointed spectators who had expected an exciting final.
entries.zh: 这场零比零的平局让原本期待一场精彩决赛的观众失望了。

entries.en: The essay examines the fictional government's commitment to non-alignment during the crisis.
entries.zh: 这篇文章考察了那个虚构政府在危机中对不结盟立场的坚持。

entries.en: In the novel, a non-combatant helps the wounded messenger find the hospital.
entries.zh: 小说中，一名非战斗人员帮助受伤的信使找到医院。

entries.en: The apparent non-existence of a second entrance forced the characters to reconsider their escape plan.
entries.zh: 第二个入口似乎并不存在，这迫使人物们重新考虑逃跑计划。

entries.en: She moved from non-fiction to novels after years of writing about local history.
entries.zh: 写了多年地方史后，她从非虚构写作转向了小说创作。

entries.en: The historian asks whether non-intervention was a deliberate policy or merely a lack of resources.
entries.zh: 历史学家探讨了不干预究竟是有意的政策，还是仅仅由于缺乏资源。

entries.en: A non-member asked whether she could attend the club's open lecture.
entries.zh: 一位非会员询问是否可以参加俱乐部的公开讲座。

entries.en: The letter concerned non-payment of an invoice that the customer said had never arrived.
entries.zh: 那封信涉及一张未付款的发票，而客户说自己从未收到过这张发票。

entries.en: In the story, a non-resident challenges the town's proposed parking charges.
entries.zh: 故事中，一位非居民对镇上拟议的停车收费提出了异议。

entries.meaningZh: 毫无成功希望的提议或事物〔口语〕
entries.en: A midnight rehearsal was a non-starter because most players relied on the last bus.
entries.zh: 午夜排练根本行不通，因为大多数演奏者都得赶末班公交车。

entries.en: Her commitment to non-violence shaped the way the protest was organised.
entries.zh: 她坚持非暴力的立场，影响了抗议活动的组织方式。

entries.en: Mud covered the number plate, so he cleaned it before photographing the car.
entries.zh: 泥土遮住了车牌，于是他先擦净车牌，再给车拍照。

entries.en: The nursery nurse noticed that the new child preferred drawing to joining the singing.
entries.zh: 保育员注意到，新来的孩子比起参加唱歌更喜欢画画。

entries.en: We inspected the obstacle course before deciding where spectators could stand.
entries.zh: 我们先查看了障碍赛场地，再决定观众可以站在哪里。

entries.en: The occupational therapist asked which everyday tasks the patient most wanted to manage independently.
entries.zh: 职能治疗师询问患者最希望独立完成哪些日常活动。

entries.meaningZh: 身体不适或状态不佳的一天
entries.en: Even on an off day, when she felt unwell, she managed a short walk.
entries.zh: 即使在身体不舒服、状态不佳的日子里，她也设法走了一小段路。

entries.en: I knocked on the door on the off-chance that someone had found my missing scarf.
entries.zh: 我抱着极小的希望敲了门，想看看是否有人捡到了我丢失的围巾。

entries.en: Their enthusiasm for off-roading faded after a weekend of cleaning mud from the vehicle.
entries.zh: 周末花时间清理车上的泥后，他们对越野驾驶的热情减退了。

entries.en: The fictional party uses the off-year to rebuild its local organisation.
entries.zh: 那个虚构政党利用非大选年来重建地方组织。

entries.en: The notice gave the office hours but omitted the telephone number.
entries.zh: 通知写明了办公时间，却漏掉了电话号码。

entries.en: The novel's office-holder refuses a gift from the contractor seeking his support.
entries.zh: 小说中的那位公职人员拒绝了一个寻求他支持的承包商送来的礼物。

entries.en: The mechanic found a dent in the oil pan while inspecting the underside of the engine.
entries.zh: 机修工检查发动机底部时，发现承油盘上有一处凹陷。

entries.en: A supply boat appears beside the oil platform in the opening scene of the film.
entries.zh: 影片开场时，一艘补给船出现在石油平台旁。

entries.en: A field of oilseed rape stretched beyond the abandoned railway bridge.
entries.zh: 一片油菜地延伸到废弃铁路桥的那一边。

entries.en: The memoir describes how her first old age pension changed her weekly budget.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了她领到第一笔养老年金后，每周的收支安排发生了怎样的变化。

entries.meaningZh: 讨厌的老太婆〔侮辱性口语〕
entries.en: The narrator calls his neighbour an old bat, revealing more about his own cruelty than about her.
entries.zh: 叙述者把邻居称为讨厌的老太婆，这反而更显出了他自己的刻薄。

entries.en: An unexpected letter from an old flame interrupted his quiet retirement.
entries.zh: 旧情人一封意外的来信打破了他平静的退休生活。

entries.en: An old girl of the school returned to help catalogue its photographs.
entries.zh: 一位女校友返校，帮助整理学校的照片目录。

entries.meaningZh: 独自包办各项工作的人
entries.en: The tiny publisher was a one-man band, with its owner editing, printing and delivering every issue.
entries.zh: 那家小出版社全靠一个人撑着，老板包办了每期的编辑、印刷和配送。

entries.en: The novel portrays a one-parent family without treating its daily life as unusual.
entries.zh: 小说描写了一个单亲家庭，却没有把它的日常生活视为异样。

entries.en: At the college's open day, we spent most of our time in the sculpture workshop.
entries.zh: 学院开放日那天，我们大部分时间都待在雕塑工作室。

entries.en: In the case study, the council considers selling the unused building on the open market.
entries.zh: 案例中，地方议会考虑在公开市场上出售那栋闲置建筑。

entries.meaningZh: 开放式监狱；不设防监狱
entries.en: The documentary follows a teacher preparing a new course at an open prison.
entries.zh: 纪录片记录了一位教师在开放式监狱筹备新课程的过程。

entries.en: Whether the club can afford another season remains an open question.
entries.zh: 俱乐部是否负担得起再参加一个赛季，仍是个悬而未决的问题。

entries.en: The fictional island's council debates shortening the open season after receiving conflicting reports.
entries.zh: 收到相互矛盾的报告后，那个虚构岛屿的议会讨论了缩短解禁期间的问题。

entries.en: Her open-mindedness allowed the rehearsal to change direction when the youngest actor made a suggestion.
entries.zh: 最年轻的演员提出建议时，她开放的态度让排练得以调整方向。

entries.en: I checked the library's opening hours before making the long bus journey.
entries.zh: 坐公交车远行之前，我查看了图书馆的开放时间。

entries.en: We arrived before opening time and waited beside the locked shop door.
entries.zh: 我们在开门营业前就到了，在锁着的店门旁等候。

entries.en: The old advice book assumes that every reader wants to impress the opposite sex.
entries.zh: 那本旧建议手册假定每位读者都想给异性留下好印象。

entries.en: The rescued orang-utan examined the new climbing frame before moving towards it.
entries.zh: 那只获救的猩猩先打量了新攀爬架，再朝它移动。

entries.en: An orang-utang appears briefly in the wildlife film, resting beneath a broad leaf.
entries.zh: 野生动物影片中短暂出现了一只猩猩，它正在一片宽大的叶子下休息。

entries.en: I enjoyed orienteering more once I stopped following the fastest runner and read my own map.
entries.zh: 不再跟着跑得最快的人、而是自己看地图后，我更喜欢定向越野了。

entries.en: My other half offered to collect the cake while I decorated the hall.
entries.zh: 我布置大厅时，我的另一半主动提出去取蛋糕。

entries.en: She placed the signed letters in the out tray and returned to the unfinished report.
entries.zh: 她把签好的信放进发件盘，又接着写未完成的报告。

entries.en: The director kept the out-take in which a passing dog interrupted the dramatic farewell.
entries.zh: 导演保留了那个剪掉的镜头，其中一只路过的狗打断了戏剧性的告别场面。

entries.en: Their monthly outgoings rose after they began renting a rehearsal room.
entries.zh: 开始租排练室后，他们每月的开销增加了。

entries.en: Rain delayed the outside broadcast, leaving the presenter to describe the empty stage.
entries.zh: 下雨耽误了实况转播，主持人只好描述那座空舞台。

entries.en: In the fictional election, no party secures an overall majority.
entries.zh: 在那场虚构的选举中，没有哪个政党获得绝对多数票。

entries.en: The shop sells its own brand alongside products from larger manufacturers.
entries.zh: 这家店既销售自有商标的产品，也销售较大厂商的产品。

entries.en: The buyer rejected the package deal because it included equipment she did not need.
entries.zh: 买方拒绝了这项一揽子交易，因为其中包含她不需要的设备。

entries.en: My packed lunch survived the journey, but the apple bruised against the flask.
entries.zh: 我的自带午餐一路上安然无恙，不过苹果碰着保温瓶，被碰伤了。

entries.en: The lecturer used a diagram to explain packet switching before discussing delays in the network.
entries.zh: 讲师先用示意图讲解分组交换，再讨论网络延迟。

entries.en: The film depicts the padded cell without showing the person confined inside it.
entries.zh: 影片呈现了那间四周设软垫的病室，却没有拍出里面被关着的人。

entries.en: A fallen leaf floated across the deserted paddling pool after the children went indoors.
entries.zh: 孩子们进屋后，一片落叶漂过了已无人在玩的嬉水池。

entries.en: The conservator postponed choosing a paint stripper until the surface had been examined.
entries.zh: 修复师把选择脱漆剂的事推迟到检查表面之后。

entries.en: The old palmcorder still held a recording of our first concert.
entries.zh: 那台旧掌上摄像机里还保存着我们首场音乐会的录像。

entries.en: A gust of wind sent his panama hat into the shallow fountain.
entries.zh: 一阵风把他的巴拿马式草帽吹进了浅水喷泉里。

entries.en: The paper shop kept my magazine behind the counter until I returned from holiday.
entries.zh: 我度假期间，报刊店把我的杂志留在柜台后，等我回来。

entries.en: The parent-teacher association raised enough money to repair the school garden's gate.
entries.zh: 家长教师协会筹到了足够的钱来修学校花园的大门。

entries.en: She discussed parental leave with her manager before the team planned its next project.
entries.zh: 团队规划下一个项目前，她与经理讨论了育婴假的事。

entries.en: The park-keeper found a lost sketchbook beside the locked tennis courts.
entries.zh: 公园管理员在锁着的网球场旁发现了一本遗失的速写本。

entries.meaningZh: 停车楼；停车场〔美式用语〕
entries.en: We forgot which level of the parking garage held our car.
entries.zh: 我们忘了车停在停车楼的哪一层。

entries.meaningZh: 临别时的最后一句话或举动
entries.en: His parting shot about the untidy kitchen ruined an otherwise pleasant visit.
entries.zh: 他临走时对厨房凌乱的那句挖苦，破坏了原本愉快的拜访。

entries.meaningZh: 社交场合常表演的拿手节目
entries.en: Her party piece involved balancing a spoon while reciting a comic poem.
entries.zh: 她在聚会上的拿手节目是边保持勺子平衡边朗诵滑稽诗。

entries.en: The volunteers wanted the campaign to stay clear of party politics.
entries.zh: 志愿者们希望这场活动不卷入党派政治。

entries.en: The last party-goer helped carry the empty bottles downstairs.
entries.zh: 最后一位聚会参加者帮忙把空瓶子搬下了楼。

entries.en: The survey asked residents about passive smoking without assuming where the exposure occurred.
entries.zh: 调查询问居民被动吸烟的情况，并未预先认定烟雾接触发生在哪里。

entries.en: He arranged paternity leave before agreeing to take on another project.
entries.zh: 他先安排好陪产假，再同意接手另一个项目。

entries.en: A bird's reflection in the patio door distracted the cat.
entries.zh: 露台玻璃门里一只鸟的倒影吸引了猫的注意。

entries.en: The artist changed the patterning on the fabric but kept the original colours.
entries.zh: 艺术家改变了布料上的图案结构，却保留了原来的颜色。

entries.en: Her first pay cheque arrived just before the rent was due.
entries.zh: 她的第一张工资支票刚好在房租到期前寄到。

entries.en: We postponed the purchase until pay day rather than borrow from a friend.
entries.zh: 我们把购买推迟到发薪日，而没有向朋友借钱。

entries.en: Their paying guest offered to water the garden while they were away.
entries.zh: 他们家的寄膳宿者提出在他们外出期间帮忙浇花园。

entries.meaningZh: 削减国防开支后可用于公共事业的经费
entries.en: The fictional council argues over how a peace dividend should be divided between schools and transport.
entries.zh: 那个虚构议会争论应如何把削减国防开支节省的经费分配给学校和交通。

entries.en: We waited until after peak time before trying to cross the city.
entries.zh: 我们等到高峰期过后，才试着穿过市区。

entries.en: She saved her teacher's pearls of wisdom in the margins of her rehearsal notebook.
entries.zh: 她把老师的睿智话语记在排练笔记本的页边。

entries.en: The pedal bin would not close because a cardboard box was caught beneath the lid.
entries.zh: 一个纸盒卡在盖子下面，踏板垃圾桶关不上了。

entries.en: The new pedestrian mall gave the musicians room to perform without blocking a doorway.
entries.zh: 新的步行街给了乐手表演的空间，不必堵在人家门口。

entries.en: We left the car outside the pedestrian precinct and walked to the bookshop.
entries.zh: 我们把车停在步行街区外，步行去书店。

entries.en: Their game of peepbo ended when the baby pulled the scarf from his father's face.
entries.zh: 宝宝把围巾从爸爸脸上扯下来时，这场藏脸游戏结束了。

entries.en: The actor asked for a lighter peg leg for the final rehearsal.
entries.zh: 那名演员要求最后一次排练时换一条更轻的木制假腿。

entries.en: The narrator dismisses the clerk as a pen-pusher before discovering how much work she does.
entries.zh: 叙述者起初不屑地把那名办事员叫作耍笔杆子的，后来才发现她做了多少工作。

entries.en: The historical novel follows a prisoner released after years of penal servitude.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说讲述了一名服劳役刑多年后获释的囚犯的经历。

entries.en: The defender slipped just outside the penalty area as the ball approached.
entries.zh: 球靠近时，防守队员在罚球区外侧滑倒了。

entries.en: The penalty shoot-out kept the remaining spectators in their seats long after sunset.
entries.zh: 点球大战让剩下的观众一直留在座位上，直到日落后很久。

entries.en: My penfriend sent a sketch of her street instead of a photograph.
entries.zh: 我的笔友寄来的是她所住街道的速写，而不是照片。

entries.en: The fictional employee asks for a written explanation of the pension scheme before making a choice.
entries.zh: 那个虚构雇员要求先拿到退休金计划的书面说明，再作选择。

entries.en: We folded the rear seats of the people carrier to make room for the instruments.
entries.zh: 我们折起那辆多排座家庭轿车的后排座椅，腾出地方放乐器。

entries.meaningZh: 定点运送乘客的交通工具
entries.en: The airport's people mover stopped briefly between the two terminals.
entries.zh: 机场的旅客运输车在两个航站楼之间短暂停了一下。

entries.en: The pepperpot rolled beneath the table when someone knocked the tray.
entries.zh: 有人碰了托盘一下，胡椒瓶滚到了桌子底下。

entries.en: She recorded a personal best despite losing her rhythm on the final lap.
entries.zh: 虽然最后一圈节奏乱了，她仍创造了个人最佳成绩。

entries.en: The novel begins with an oddly worded notice in the newspaper's personal column.
entries.zh: 小说以报纸私人广告栏里一则措辞奇特的启事开篇。

entries.en: He stepped back to give the nervous interviewee more personal space.
entries.zh: 他往后退了一步，给那位紧张的受访者更多个人空间。

entries.en: Her old personal stereo played the tape too slowly, making every song sound unfamiliar.
entries.zh: 她的旧随身听播放磁带太慢，每首歌听起来都变得陌生。

entries.en: The fictional minister's speech explains how the government plans to use its petrodollars.
entries.zh: 那个虚构部长的讲话解释了政府打算如何使用石油美元。

entries.en: The class compared the two phenomena rather than assuming they shared the same cause.
entries.zh: 全班比较了这两种现象，没有预先认定它们有相同的原因。

entries.en: We sheltered beside the phone box while trying to unfold the damp map.
entries.zh: 我们躲在电话亭旁，一边试着展开受潮的地图。

entries.en: He found an unused phonecard inside the guidebook he had bought second-hand.
entries.zh: 他在二手买来的旅行指南里发现了一张没用过的电话卡。

entries.en: The photo shoot moved indoors when the wind began blowing sand across the beach.
entries.zh: 风开始把沙子吹得满海滩都是，照片拍摄便转到了室内。

entries.en: The photo-finish settled a race that looked like a tie from the stands.
entries.zh: 看台上的人觉得比赛像是平局，最终由摄影判定了胜负。

entries.en: The restored pianola drew a crowd when its keys began moving without a player.
entries.zh: 修复后的自动钢琴琴键在无人弹奏时开始移动，吸引了一群人围观。

entries.en: The shop's owner noticed a pick-up in trade after the bridge reopened.
entries.zh: 桥重新开放后，店主注意到生意有了好转。

entries.en: She used picture messaging to show the repairer the damaged hinge.
entries.zh: 她用手机彩信向修理师傅展示受损的铰链。

entries.en: His pig-headedness kept the team arguing long after everyone else wanted a compromise.
entries.zh: 其他人早就想妥协了，他的固执却让团队还在争论。

entries.en: The historical novel's pilot officer receives a letter from home before the briefing.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说中的皇家空军少尉在任务简报前收到了一封家书。

entries.en: The history class compared two maps showing the proposed pincer movement.
entries.zh: 历史课上，全班比较了两张描绘拟议钳形行动的地图。

entries.en: A pine cone rolled from her coat pocket onto the train seat.
entries.zh: 一颗松果从她的外套口袋滚到了火车座位上。

entries.en: We played ping-pong in the garage until the ball disappeared behind a cupboard.
entries.zh: 我们在车库打乒乓球，直到球不见了，掉到了橱柜后面。

entries.meaningZh: 公共场所连续播放的背景轻音乐
entries.en: The piped music made it difficult to hear the guide explaining the painting.
entries.zh: 背景轻音乐让人难以听清导览员对画作的讲解。

entries.en: He mistook her serious suggestion for a piss-take and laughed at the wrong moment.
entries.zh: 他把她认真的建议误当成戏弄，在不该笑的时候笑了。

entries.en: The match stopped after a pitch invasion, leaving both teams waiting by the tunnel.
entries.zh: 观众涌入球场后，比赛暂停，两队都在通道旁等候。

entries.en: The place card put me beside a stranger who shared my interest in old maps.
entries.zh: 席次牌把我安排在一个陌生人旁边，后来发现对方也喜欢旧地图。

entries.en: The final placings changed after the judges corrected a recording error.
entries.zh: 裁判纠正一处记录错误后，最终名次发生了变化。

entries.en: She chose plain chocolate for the filling because her older brother disliked the sweeter version.
entries.zh: 她选择用黑巧克力做馅，因为她的哥哥不喜欢更甜的那一种。

entries.meaningZh: 建筑规划许可〔英式用语〕
entries.en: In the story, the owner seeks planning permission before converting the old mill.
entries.zh: 故事中，业主在改造旧磨坊前申请建筑规划许可。

entries.en: The plant pot cracked when I moved it from the cold balcony into the warm kitchen.
entries.zh: 我把花盆从寒冷的阳台搬进暖和的厨房时，它裂开了。

entries.en: The old plasma screen showed a faint mark where the menu had remained.
entries.zh: 那块旧等离子屏上，菜单原先停留的位置留下了一道淡淡的痕迹。

entries.en: The museum kept the plastic bullet behind glass beside a carefully worded description.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那枚塑料子弹放在玻璃后面，旁边配有措辞谨慎的说明。

entries.en: The player-manager left the field early to discuss the next substitution with her assistant.
entries.zh: 那位队员兼主教练提早离场，与助手讨论下一次换人。

entries.en: The costume designer found a pair of plus-fours for the actor playing the retired golfer.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为饰演退休高尔夫球手的演员找来了一条宽大灯笼裤。

entries.meaningZh: 诗歌为韵律等采用的语法破格
entries.en: The tutor accepted the unusual grammar as poetic licence rather than correcting the line.
entries.zh: 导师认为这种不寻常的语法属于诗歌破格，没有改那行诗。

entries.en: The survey asked which information customers wanted at the point of sale.
entries.zh: 调查询问顾客希望在销售点获得哪些信息。

entries.en: The poison-pen letter accused the organiser without offering any evidence or naming its writer.
entries.zh: 那封匿名恶意信指责组织者，却没有提供任何证据，也没有署名。

entries.en: The theatre's programme listed pole dancing alongside aerial acrobatics.
entries.zh: 剧院的节目单把钢管舞与高空杂技并列列出。

entries.en: The novel follows a musician waiting for a decision on her request for political asylum.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一位音乐家等待政治庇护申请结果的经历。

entries.en: In the fictional town, polling continues while reporters wait outside the council hall.
entries.zh: 在那个虚构小镇上，选举投票仍在进行，记者们在议会大厅外等候。

entries.en: The sweater's polo neck felt too tight beneath his winter coat.
entries.zh: 那件毛衣的圆高领穿在冬季外套里面，让他觉得太紧。

entries.en: The archive had become the poor relation of the museum, receiving little space or funding.
entries.zh: 档案馆成了博物馆里不受重视的部分，分到的空间和经费都很少。

entries.en: The exhibition of pop art led her to reconsider the packaging she usually threw away.
entries.zh: 那场波普艺术展让她重新审视自己平常随手丢掉的包装。

entries.en: A broken poppadom left crumbs across the menu before the meal began.
entries.zh: 还没开饭，一块碎掉的印度薄脆饼就把碎屑撒得菜单上到处都是。

entries.en: The teacher asked us to replace the repeated name with a possessive pronoun.
entries.zh: 老师让我们用一个所有格代词替换重复出现的名字。

entries.en: She rented a post office box so the club's letters would not arrive at her home.
entries.zh: 她租了一个邮政信箱，这样俱乐部的信就不会寄到她家里。

entries.en: The reading group discussed post-modernism through a novel with several unreliable narrators.
entries.zh: 读书小组通过一本有多个不可靠叙述者的小说来讨论后现代主义。

entries.en: The post-modernist challenged the critic's assumption that a novel must have one stable viewpoint.
entries.zh: 那位后现代主义者质疑了评论家的假设：小说必须具有一个稳定的视角。

entries.en: The missing sound recording caused an unexpected delay in post-production.
entries.zh: 一段录音丢失，导致后期制作意外延误。

entries.en: The postie found the parcel beneath the empty letter tray.
entries.zh: 邮递员在空信件盘下面找到了包裹。

entries.meaningZh: 现成饭菜；有什么吃什么
entries.en: We arrived too late for a special meal and had to take pot luck.
entries.zh: 我们来得太晚，来不及专门做饭，只能有什么吃什么。

entries.en: Their plans for potholing changed after the guide inspected the weather forecast.
entries.zh: 向导查看天气预报后，他们更改了洞穴探险计划。

entries.en: The bag of potting compost split before she reached the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 她还没走到温室，装盆栽用土的袋子就裂开了。

entries.en: An unfinished birdhouse stood on the bench inside the potting shed.
entries.zh: 盆栽棚里的工作台上放着一个未完工的鸟屋。

entries.en: We held a brief pow-wow about the seating plan before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来前，我们就座位安排简短商议了一番。

entries.en: The novel shows how the mayor's power base weakens when the factory closes.
entries.zh: 小说描写了工厂关闭后，市长的权力基础如何受到削弱。

entries.en: A power cut interrupted the rehearsal just as the chorus began.
entries.zh: 合唱刚开始，一次断电就中断了排练。

entries.en: The essay questions whether the painter's early pre-eminence has overshadowed her later experiments.
entries.zh: 这篇文章探讨了那位画家早期的杰出地位是否掩盖了她后来的探索。

entries.meaningZh: 未满十三岁的儿童〔常指九至十二岁〕
entries.en: The workshop paired each pre-teen with an older volunteer for the model-building activity.
entries.zh: 在模型制作活动中，工作坊给每名未满十三岁的儿童安排了一位年龄较大的志愿者。

entries.en: The fictional retailer denies predatory pricing, while the seminar asks what evidence would be needed.
entries.zh: 那个虚构零售商否认掠夺性定价，而研讨课讨论需要哪些证据才能判断。

entries.en: The grammar exercise asks where the predeterminer belongs in the noun phrase.
entries.zh: 这道语法练习要求指出前置限定词在名词短语中的位置。

entries.en: Her maternal aunt found an old premium bond among the papers in the locked drawer.
entries.zh: 她的姨妈在锁着的抽屉里的文件中发现了一张旧的抽签有奖债券。

entries.en: In the novel, a preservation order complicates the owner's plan to demolish the old theatre.
entries.zh: 小说中，一份保护令使业主拆除旧剧院的计划变得复杂起来。

entries.meaningZh: 新闻发布官；新闻发言人
entries.en: The press officer asked reporters to wait while the missing figures were checked.
entries.zh: 核对遗漏的数据时，新闻发言人请记者们稍候。
